natural: Flowery words and clever talk

meaning.en: Sweet talk; fine-sounding but deceptive words.
meaning.zh: 原指铺张修饰而无实际内容的言语或文辞，后多指用来骗人的虚伪动听的话。

examples.zh: 别被他的花言巧语骗了。
examples.en: Don't be taken in by his sweet talk.

examples.zh: 推销员花言巧语，老人买了一堆没用的保健品。
examples.en: The salesman smooth-talked the old man into buying a pile of useless supplements.

usage.en: Usually subject or object (他的花言巧语). Derogatory.

natural: Equal in power, matched in strength

meaning.en: Evenly matched.
meaning.zh: 双方势力相当，不分高低。

examples.zh: 两支球队势均力敌，比赛十分精彩。
examples.en: The two teams were evenly matched, and it was a thrilling game.

examples.zh: 这次选举两位候选人势均力敌。
examples.en: The two candidates are neck and neck in this election.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Displaying the new and setting up the different

meaning.en: To be deliberately different or original (sometimes just to stand out).
meaning.zh: 提出新奇的主张，表示与众不同。

equivalents: be different for the sake of it

examples.zh: 他的设计标新立异，引起了很大争议。
examples.en: His unconventional design caused a lot of controversy.

examples.zh: 写作文不必为了标新立异而故意偏题。
examples.en: Don't go off-topic in an essay just to be different.

origin.source: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·文学》

story.en: The monk Zhi Dun's commentary on Zhuangzi was said to "display new principles beyond the two schools and set up different meanings beyond all the sages" (标新理于二家之表，立异义于众贤之外).
story.zh: 《世说新语》称支道林注《逍遥游》："标新理于二家之表，立异义于众贤之外。"

usage.en: Predicate. Can praise originality or criticise attention-seeking.

natural: Making camp at every step

meaning.en: To advance step by step, securing each gain.
meaning.zh: 军队每推进一步就设下一道营垒。比喻行动谨慎，防备严密。

examples.zh: 谈判时我们要步步为营，不能急于求成。
examples.en: In the negotiations we must proceed step by step and not rush.

examples.zh: 他步步为营，最终拿下了整个市场。
examples.en: Securing each gain as he went, he eventually took the whole market.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.

natural: So much has built up it's hard to reverse

meaning.en: Long-standing problems that are hard to fix.
meaning.zh: 长期形成的问题不易解决，也指长期形成的坏习惯不易改变。

equivalents: past the point of no return

examples.zh: 这些问题积重难返，改革需要时间。
examples.en: These problems are deeply entrenched; reform will take time.

examples.zh: 坏习惯要早改，否则积重难返。
examples.en: Break bad habits early, or they'll become impossible to shake.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal; institutions, habits.

natural: Roaming the hills and enjoying the rivers

meaning.en: To go sightseeing; to enjoy travelling around.
meaning.zh: 游览、玩赏山水景色。

examples.zh: 退休后，他们到处游山玩水。
examples.en: Since retiring, they've been travelling around seeing the sights.

examples.zh: 出差不是游山玩水，要把工作做好。
examples.en: A business trip isn't for sightseeing — get the work done.

usage.en: Predicate. Neutral; can hint at idleness.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，有时略含不务正业之意。

natural: Living by the mountains, you live off the mountains

meaning.en: To make a living from local resources; to use what's at hand.
meaning.zh: 住在山区就靠山上的资源生活。比喻利用当地的条件谋生。

equivalents: make the most of local resources

examples.zh: 靠山吃山，靠水吃水，这里的人世代以采茶为生。
examples.en: People live off what's around them — here they've picked tea for generations.

examples.zh: 村里靠山吃山，发展起了乡村旅游。
examples.en: Making use of its mountains, the village has developed rural tourism.

usage.en: Usually in the full saying 靠山吃山，靠水吃水. Can also hint at exploiting one's position.
usage.zh: 常说"靠山吃山，靠水吃水"。也可比喻利用职务之便。

natural: Knowing one thing and half-understanding it

meaning.en: A superficial, half-baked understanding.
meaning.zh: 知道得不全面，理解得也不透彻。

equivalents: a little knowledge is a dangerous thing

examples.zh: 他对法律一知半解，却到处给人出主意。
examples.en: He has only a superficial grasp of the law but gives everyone advice.

examples.zh: 学习不能满足于一知半解。
examples.en: Don't be content with half-understanding things.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or object. In speech 一 is yì.

natural: Refined and courteous

meaning.en: Courteous and well-mannered.
meaning.zh: 形容文雅而有礼貌。

examples.zh: 服务员彬彬有礼，让客人感到很舒服。
examples.en: The staff were courteous and made the guests feel at ease.

examples.zh: 他对谁都彬彬有礼。
examples.en: He's polite to everyone.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

natural: A strange idea, as if the sky would open

meaning.en: Wildly fanciful; pie in the sky.
meaning.zh: 形容想法很不切实际，非常离奇。

examples.zh: 不学习就想考满分，真是异想天开。
examples.en: Expecting full marks without studying is pure wishful thinking.

examples.zh: 当年人们觉得登月是异想天开。
examples.en: People once thought landing on the moon was a pipe dream.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually critical, sometimes admiring of bold imagination.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含贬义，有时指大胆想象。

natural: Confining oneself to the old way of walking

meaning.en: To stand still and refuse to progress; complacent.
meaning.zh: 比喻安于现状，不求进步。

examples.zh: 企业如果故步自封，迟早会被淘汰。
examples.en: A company that rests on its laurels will sooner or later be left behind.

examples.zh: 取得成绩后不能故步自封。
examples.en: Don't become complacent after success.

usage.en: Predicate. 故 = old. 固步自封 is a common but less standard variant.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。规范写法为"故步自封"。

natural: Every thing used to the full

meaning.en: To make full use of everything; nothing goes to waste.
meaning.zh: 各种东西凡有可用之处，都要尽量利用。

examples.zh: 旧衣服可以改成抹布，物尽其用。
examples.en: Old clothes can become cleaning rags — waste not, want not.

examples.zh: 要做到人尽其才，物尽其用。
examples.en: Make the most of every person's talent and every resource.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 人尽其才.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"人尽其才"连用。

natural: Tried again and again without fail

meaning.en: Tried and tested; works every time.
meaning.zh: 屡次试验都没有差错。

examples.zh: 这个治打嗝的方法屡试不爽。
examples.en: This hiccup cure works every time.

examples.zh: 他用这招对付对手，屡试不爽。
examples.en: He uses this trick against opponents and it never fails.

usage.en: Predicate. 爽 here means "err", not "pleasant" — so it means "never fails", not "never satisfying".

natural: Face red and ears crimson

meaning.en: Red in the face (from anger, embarrassment or exertion).
meaning.zh: 脸和耳朵都红了。形容因急躁、害羞或发怒等而脸色发红的样子。

equivalents: blush to the roots of one's hair

examples.zh: 两人为一点小事争得面红耳赤。
examples.en: The two argued till they were red in the face over a trifle.

examples.zh: 被老师当众表扬，她羞得面红耳赤。
examples.en: Praised in front of the class, she blushed bright red.

usage.en: Complement (争得面红耳赤) or predicate.

literal: Jing river · Wei river · distinct · clear
natural: As distinct as the Jing and Wei rivers

meaning.en: Clearly distinct; a clear line between two things.
meaning.zh: 泾水清，渭水浊，两水相汇处清浊分明。比喻界限清楚或是非分明。

equivalents: as different as chalk and cheese

examples.zh: 公私要泾渭分明。
examples.en: Keep a clear line between public and private.

examples.zh: 两种观点泾渭分明，没有妥协余地。
examples.en: The two views are clear-cut opposites with no room for compromise.

story.en: The Book of Songs: "The Jing is muddied by the Wei" (泾以渭浊). Where the two rivers meet near Xi'an, their clear and muddy waters run side by side without mixing.
story.zh: 《诗经·谷风》："泾以渭浊。"泾河与渭河在西安附近交汇，清浊分明。

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Grasped by the heart and understood by the spirit

meaning.en: To understand without being told; to take the hint.
meaning.zh: 不用明说，心里已经领会。

examples.zh: 老师使了个眼色，他立刻心领神会。
examples.en: The teacher gave him a look, and he got the message straight away.

examples.zh: 两人合作多年，一个眼神就能心领神会。
examples.en: After years together, they understand each other with a glance.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Hitting the vital point exactly

meaning.en: To hit the nail on the head; to address the crux.
meaning.zh: 正好击中要害部位。指批评或说话正好说到关键地方。

equivalents: hit the nail on the head
get to the heart of the matter

examples.zh: 他的分析切中要害，大家都很佩服。
examples.en: His analysis hit the nail on the head, and everyone was impressed.

examples.zh: 这篇评论切中要害，指出了政策的问题。
examples.en: The commentary got to the heart of the policy's problems.

usage.en: Predicate. 切 is qiè (exactly); 中 is zhòng (hit).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"切"读 qiè，"中"读 zhòng。

natural: Modest and prudent

meaning.en: Modest and prudent.
meaning.zh: 虚心，不自满，言行慎重。

equivalents: keep one's feet on the ground

examples.zh: 取得成绩后，仍要谦虚谨慎。
examples.en: Even after success, stay modest and prudent.

examples.zh: 他为人谦虚谨慎，深受大家尊重。
examples.en: He's modest and careful, and widely respected.

usage.en: Predicate. A set phrase in official praise (often 戒骄戒躁).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"戒骄戒躁"连用。

natural: A tiger's head with a snake's tail

meaning.en: A strong start but a weak finish.
meaning.zh: 头大如虎，尾细如蛇。比喻开始时声势很大，到后来劲头很小，有始无终。

equivalents: start with a bang and end with a whimper

examples.zh: 做事要有始有终，不能虎头蛇尾。
examples.en: Finish what you start — don't let it fizzle out.

examples.zh: 这部剧开头精彩，结尾却虎头蛇尾。
examples.en: The series started brilliantly but ended with a whimper.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: A dragonfly dipping the water's surface

meaning.en: Superficial; only skimming the surface.
meaning.zh: 蜻蜓在水面飞行时用尾部轻触水面。比喻做事肤浅不深入。

examples.zh: 他复习只是蜻蜓点水，没有深入。
examples.en: His revision only skimmed the surface.

examples.zh: 检查工作不能蜻蜓点水，要发现真问题。
examples.en: Inspections can't just scratch the surface — they need to find real problems.

story.en: Du Fu's poem: "Butterflies flit deep among the flowers; dragonflies dip the water as they slowly fly" (点水蜻蜓款款飞).
story.zh: 杜甫《曲江》："穿花蛱蝶深深见，点水蜻蜓款款飞。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Critical of superficial work.

natural: Splitting, crumbling and falling apart

meaning.en: To fall apart; to disintegrate.
meaning.zh: 形容国家或集团分裂瓦解。

examples.zh: 王朝末期，国家分崩离析。
examples.en: At the end of the dynasty, the country fell apart.

examples.zh: 领导人去世后，这个组织很快分崩离析。
examples.en: After the leader died, the organisation quickly disintegrated.

story.en: Confucius criticised the Ji family for planning a war abroad while their own state was "divided, crumbling and falling apart, unable to hold together" (邦分崩离析而不能守也).
story.zh: 《论语·季氏》："邦分崩离析而不能守也，而谋动干戈于邦内。"

usage.en: Predicate. States, organisations, families.

pinyin: xīn yǒu yú ér lì bù zú
literal: heart · have · surplus · but · strength · not · enough
natural: The heart is willing but the strength isn't there

meaning.en: Willing but unable; wanting to help but lacking the means.
meaning.zh: 心里很想做，但是力量不够。

equivalents: the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak
I'd love to, but I can't

examples.zh: 我很想帮你，可是心有余而力不足。
examples.en: I'd love to help you, but I just can't.

examples.zh: 爷爷想陪孙子踢球，却心有余而力不足。
examples.en: Grandpa wants to play football with his grandson, but his body won't let him.

usage.en: Predicate or standalone clause. Often an apologetic refusal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或单独成句，常用于婉拒。

natural: Iron-clad evidence, solid as a mountain

meaning.en: Irrefutable evidence.
meaning.zh: 确凿的证据像山一样不可动摇。

examples.zh: 铁证如山，他不得不认罪。
examples.en: Faced with irrefutable evidence, he had to confess.

examples.zh: 历史铁证如山，不容否认。
examples.en: The historical evidence is irrefutable and cannot be denied.

usage.en: Predicate or standalone clause.

natural: Measure the body before cutting the cloth

meaning.en: To tailor one's approach to the actual situation.
meaning.zh: 按照身材裁剪衣服。比喻按照实际情况办事。

equivalents: cut one's coat according to one's cloth

examples.zh: 制定计划要量体裁衣，不能好高骛远。
examples.en: Plans must be tailored to reality — don't overreach.

examples.zh: 老师根据每个学生的情况量体裁衣。
examples.en: The teacher tailors the approach to each student.

usage.en: Predicate. 量 is liàng.

natural: Returning the jade disc intact to Zhao

meaning.en: To return something intact to its owner.
meaning.zh: 把和氏璧完好地送回赵国。比喻把原物完好地归还本人。

examples.zh: 借你的书已经看完了，现在完璧归赵。
examples.en: I've finished the book you lent me — here it is back in perfect condition.

examples.zh: 这件国宝终于完璧归赵。
examples.en: The national treasure has finally been returned intact.

story.en: The King of Qin offered fifteen cities for Zhao's famous He Shi jade disc. The envoy Lin Xiangru saw Qin had no intention of paying and cleverly sent the disc back to Zhao intact.
story.zh: 秦王假意以十五城换赵国和氏璧，蔺相如识破其诈，设法派人将璧完好送回赵国。

usage.en: Predicate. Often humorous when returning borrowed things.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，归还借物时常诙谐使用。
